inclusion_rule: Document explicitly affirms that human dignity, agency, professional judgment, or relational learning must remain authoritative when GenAI is used; or asserts that GenAI must not displace teacher or learner authority in decisions affecting progression, assessment, or pedagogy
exclusion_rule: Generic mentions of ``human in the loop'' as a feature without normative force; references to human oversight only as a procedural compliance checkbox without articulating why

inclusion_rule: Document requires disclosure of GenAI use (to learners, parents, regulators), or specifies documentation, traceability, audit trails, or intelligible explanations as governance requirements
exclusion_rule: Ad hoc transparency suggestions with no operational locus

inclusion_rule: Document treats equitable access, non-discrimination, accessibility for learners with disabilities, or mitigation of the digital divide as a condition of legitimate adoption; or articulates equity as a binding design constraint
exclusion_rule: Single-sentence aspirational mentions of fairness with no further development

inclusion_rule: Document attributes responsibility for GenAI-mediated educational outcomes to a named or namable actor (ministry, institution, vendor, educator); or specifies oversight, monitoring, remedy, or grievance procedures
exclusion_rule: Vague affirmations that ``everyone is responsible'' or that ``responsible use'' is required

inclusion_rule: Document treats learner data as sensitive and articulates data minimization, lawful processing, vendor data controls, retention limits, or institutional custodianship of educational data
exclusion_rule: Generic GDPR/data-protection compliance language not specifically applied to AI

inclusion_rule: Document articulates duty of care, age-appropriate use, protection from harmful content/manipulation, psychological safety, or assessment integrity in trust-preserving terms
exclusion_rule: Generic ``safe use'' boilerplate; safety mentioned only as a parental-consent procedure

inclusion_rule: Document specifically addresses validity, reliability, defensibility, or public confidence in qualifications and assessments where GenAI is involved; or mandates assessment redesign or oversight of AI use in summative work
exclusion_rule: Brief academic-integrity reminders without engaging credential validity

inclusion_rule: Document positions media and information literacy, source verification, provenance awareness, or critical evaluation of AI outputs as core governance/educational requirements
exclusion_rule: ``Critical thinking'' mentioned generically without AI-specific articulation

inclusion_rule: Document warns about cultural homogenization, fabrication of historical narratives, loss of contextual or linguistic diversity, or AI's role in distorting collective memory
exclusion_rule: Brief mentions of ``diversity'' without cultural-heritage specificity
